title: Hunter
legacy_eligibility: standalone Hunter progression; cross-form exclusivity not assumed
notes: Hunter purchases never require vampire, wolf, or lich powers.
Voluntary hunter-replacement ceremony suspends these effects and retains historical ranks for later valid return.
Stock Sunder Armor DAMAGES enemy armor; it is not the requested reduction in durability lost from the Hunter's own equipment.
Glowing on nearby quarry is deliberately a high-level Hunt Tracking skill, not an always-on early-game radar.

Power budget reference is a comparably advanced MONK WITH NO WORN EQUIPMENT against THIS TREE WITH APPROPRIATELY-TIERED FULLY ENCHANTED/APOTHEOSIS-AFFIXED GEAR. Endgame balance targets broadly similar whole-build ability, with only slight role-specific advantages.
